prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1284; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center, with the left quarter panel and tail light assembly crushed inward. These injuries line up well with the rear-end impact described. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle. The proposed plan replaces the bumper cover and tail light, repairs and refinishes the quarter panel, and checks the trunk floor for hidden deformation. The labor hours run a little high for this scope, so I recommend a second review of the time allowances before approval. The billing shows no repeated charges.
